fusions.name: Pricked Trail
fusions.desc: A quick prick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Throws a point into it that deals 22 damage.

fusions.name: Quarry in Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Kill Is Near
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage.
